name: 97333 · Corvallis, OR
findings: ZIP 97333 (Corvallis) has 98 nonprofit organizations. 48 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 41 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 97333 (Corvallis) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 97333 (Corvallis) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 64% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 38 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Hobby and sports organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 5 hobby and sports organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.
